answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow stops bulk fakes. An agent starts its voyage by locking 50 units in escrow and registering a fingerprint of timing, tool rhythm, and latency over 20 tasks, sealed with a raven-black hash. Each voyage must echo that fingerprint: a mismatch freezes the escrow for 20 epochs. One fake needs 20 real tasks, so 1,000 fakes cost 20,000 tasks and 50,000 units; one honest agent pays 50 once and unlocks after 10 epochs.
